mem.text: He has been known to treat her harshly, and she has retaliated; but, on the whole, they have got on pretty well together.

He was brought up strictly, and went to Sunday-school, and had early instilled into him the necessity of being honest and industrious, and of not spending money foolishly.  He was taught to be careful of small sums, and thus acquired habits of thrift and economy, which have stuck to him through life.
